div.head: List of Sources

list.item:
Department of State
Indexed Central Files. One of the principal sources of documentation for this volume was the indexed central files of the Department of State. Many of the documents were selected from the following files:
611.61: U.S.-Soviet relations
762.00: German political affairs
762.0221: German territorial issues
862.181: internal travel in Germany
962.72: air transportation in Germany
Lot Files. Documents from the central files have been supplemented by lot files of the Department, which are decentralized files created by operating areas. A list of the lot files used in or consulted for this volume follows:
Ball Files: Lot 74 D 279
Files of Under Secretary of State George W. Ball, 1961-1967.
Berlin Desk Files: Lot 91 D 305
Master files of the Berlin Task Force beginning in 1961.
Berlin Desk Files: Lot 91 D 306
Various files pertaining to Live Oak planning on Berlin, 1955-1977.
Berlin Desk Files: Lot 91 D 313
Basic documents on Germany and Berlin beginning in 1944.
Bohlen Files: Lot 74 D 379
Files of Ambassador Charles E. Bohlen, 1942-1971.
Bruce Files: Lot 64 D 327
Diaries of Ambassador David K.E. Bruce, 1948-1974.
Conference Files: Lot 65 D 366
Collection of documentation on official visits by heads of government and foreign ministers to the United States and on major international conferences attended by the Secretary and Under Secretary of State for 1961, maintained by the Executive Secretariat.
Conference Files: Lot 65 D 533
Collection of documentation on official visits by heads of government and foreign ministers to the United States and on major international conferences attended by the Secretary and Under Secretary of State for 1962, maintained by the Executive Secretariat.
Conference Files: Lot 66 D 110
Collection of documentation on official visits by heads of government and foreign ministers to the United States and on major international conferences attended by the Secretary and Under Secretary of State for the years 1961-1964, maintained by the Executive Secretariat. This lot includes records on the President’s trips to Europe in 1961 and 1963.
EUR/CE Files: Lot 86 D 339
Files relating to Germany and Berlin, 1955-1972.
Hillenbrand Files: Lot 88 D 325
Files of Ambassador Martin J. Hillenbrand primarily relating to Berlin and Germany, 1950-1975.
INR-NIE Files
Files retained by the Bureau of Intelligence and Research containing copies of the National Intelligence Estimates and Special National Intelligence Estimates including the NIEs and SNIEs for 1961-1962.
Presidential Correspondence: Lot 66 D 204
Exchanges of correspondence between the President and the Secretary of State with the heads of government and foreign ministers of the United Kingdom, France, Germany, the Soviet Union, and certain other countries for the years 1953-1964, maintained by the Executive Secretariat.
Presidential Correspondence: Lot 66 D 476
Correspondence of the President with various heads of state for the years 1961-1966.
PPS Files: Lot 67 D 548
Subject files, country files, chronological files, documents, drafts, and related correspondence of the Policy Planning Staff for the years 1957-1961.
PPS Files: Lot 69 D 121
Subject files, country files, chronological files, documents, drafts, and related correspondence of the Policy Planning Staff for 1962.
Presidential Correspondence: Lot 77 D 163
Correspondence between Presidents Kennedy and Johnson and the Chairman of the Soviet Union, and other high officials of the two countries, 1961-1969.
Presidential Memoranda of Conversation: Lot 66 D 149
Memoranda of the President’s conversations for the years 1956-1964.
Rusk Files: Lot 72 D 192
Files of Secretary of State Dean Rusk, including texts of speeches and public statements, miscellaneous correspondence files, White House correspondence, chronological files, and memoranda of telephone conversations, for the years 1961-1969.
Secretary’s Memoranda of Conversation: Lot 65 D 330
Memoranda of the Secretary’s and Under Secretary of State’s conversations for the years 1961-1964.
S/S Files: Lot 68 D 350
Records of Cabinet Meetings, 1953-1965.
S/S-NSC Files: Lot 70 D 265
Master set of papers pertaining to National Security Council meetings, including policy papers, position papers, administrative documents, but not the minutes of the meetings themselves, for the years 1961-1966, maintained by the Executive Secretariat.
S/S-NSC Files: Lot 72 D 316
Master files of National Security Action Memoranda (NSAMs), 1961-1968.
S/S-NSC (Miscellaneous) Files: Lot 66 D 95
Administrative and miscellaneous National Security Council documentation, including NSC Records of Actions, for the years 1961-1964, maintained by the Executive Secretariat.
